info.name: Runtime API
info.description:
Workflow Runtime Service API - Publish, Run, and Monitor Workflows.

**Authentication:**
- JWT Token: For user-facing endpoints (publish, manage keys, view executions)
- API Key: For running workflows from external systems

**Flow:**
1. Publish workflow (JWT) → Get API key
2. Run workflow (API Key) → Get execution ID
3. Check status (JWT) → View results

variable.description: API key returned when publishing workflow

request.description: Check if the runtime service is running

item.name: 2. Publish & Manage (JWT Auth)
item.description: These endpoints require JWT authentication. Use for publishing workflows and managing API keys.

request.description:
Publish a workflow definition. Returns an API key on first publish.

**Response includes:**
- `publishedWorkflowId`: ID of the published workflow
- `apiKey.key`: The API key (SAVE THIS - only shown once!)
- `runEndpoint`: The endpoint to run this workflow
Get information about a published workflow including execution count
List all API keys for a workflow (shows prefix only, not full key)

Create a new API key for the workflow.

**IMPORTANT:** Save the returned key immediately - it will not be shown again!
Revoke (deactivate) an API key. The key will no longer work for authentication.

item.name: 3. Run Workflow (API Key Auth)
item.description: These endpoints use API Key authentication. Use X-API-Key header instead of JWT.

request.description:
Run a published workflow with input data.

**Authentication:** Uses X-API-Key header (not JWT)

**Request body:**
- `input`: JSON data to pass to the first node
- `documents`: Array of document references

**Response:**
- `executionId`: Use this to check status
- `statusEndpoint`: Endpoint to poll for completion
Run workflow with minimal input (for testing)

item.name: 4. Execution Status (JWT Auth)
item.description: Check execution status and logs. Requires JWT authentication.

request.description: List all workflow executions for the authenticated user
Get detailed execution info including status of each node
Get detailed logs for debugging execution issues

item.name: 5. Test Actions (JWT Auth)
item.description: Test individual action handlers directly (for development)
